name: Cluttered
description: Twelve maps with no square edges, packed with props and foliage to see how much life a map can hold: a fairground circle, a market bean, a sprawl, a cul-de-sac, a harbour, an old town, a supermarket, a truck stop, a beach assault, a forest with hidden bunkers, a mine with tunnels and a warehouse full of explosives.
author: Call of Slop
